# Lootura
Lootura is a quiet news and signal reader that turns live headlines from real sources into finite regional covers and evidence-backed signals.

## Canonical URLs
- Site: https://lootura.com/
- Sitemap: https://lootura.com/sitemap.xml

## Entity
- Lootura is a news and signal web application.
- It reads reviewed regional news sources, keeps a finite headline queue, and separates evidence-backed Signal pages from the main feed.
- It does not replace publishers; source links point to the original articles.

## Editions
- España (es): https://lootura.com/es/
- United States (us): https://lootura.com/us/

- México (mx): https://lootura.com/mx/

- 日本 (jp): https://lootura.com/jp/
